title: PDFweave production feature qualification
description: A traceable map from supported production features to executable tests and inspectable PDF evidence.

scenarios.title: Paper size catalog
scenarios.description: Eight physical sheets covering A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, Letter, Legal, and a custom millimeter size.

scenarios.title: Scale and alignment catalog
scenarios.description: Rendered contain, cover, none, upscale, alignment, clipping, and auto-rotation cases.

scenarios.title: Source box catalog
scenarios.description: Media, crop, bleed, trim, and art boxes plus a visible trim-to-crop fallback case.

scenarios.title: Rotation catalog
scenarios.description: A 2x2 sheet containing source pages with intrinsic 0, 90, 180, and 270 degree rotations.

scenarios.title: Fill order and collation catalog
scenarios.description: Row-major, column-major, collated-copy, and uncollated-copy output sequences.

scenarios.title: A4 boleto-style 3-up job
scenarios.description: Seven boleto-style pages packed three-up across three A4 sheets with a partial final sheet.

scenarios.title: Landscape A3 statement 4-up job
scenarios.description: Five A5 client statements packed four-up across two landscape A3 sheets.

scenarios.title: Multi-page invoice
scenarios.description: A three-page A4 invoice with repeated headings and terminal subtotal, tax, and total rows.

scenarios.title: Multi-page bank extract
scenarios.description: A three-page A4 bank extract with running balances and a terminal closing-balance row.

scenarios.title: 100 client invoice statements
scenarios.description: One 100-page A4 PDF with unique client, invoice, date, service, and amount data while the constant logo and font are embedded once.

features.name: A2-A6, Letter, Legal, and custom sheets
features.definition: Given each named preset and a custom millimeter sheet, imposition emits the requested physical dimensions and orientation.
assertions: Every named preset is normalized to exact PDF points.
Custom millimeter dimensions are converted and oriented correctly.
The combined PDF contains one inspectable page for every case.

tests.title: normalizes %s %s physical sheet dimensions
normalizes a custom millimeter sheet and applies its requested orientation
renders every named paper preset and a custom millimeter sheet

features.name: N-up grids, margins, and gutters
features.definition: Given explicit rows, columns, asymmetric margins, and gutters, every slot has deterministic top-to-bottom physical coordinates.
assertions: Exact cell rectangles are asserted numerically.
3-up A4 and 4-up landscape A3 jobs are rasterized and snapshot-tested.
Partial final sheets expose every empty slot.

tests.title: calculates exact top-to-bottom cells with asymmetric margins and gutters
packs seven boleto-style items three-up across three A4 sheets
packs five A5 client statements four-up across two landscape A3 sheets

features.name: Row-major and column-major ordering
features.definition: The same source sequence occupies different deterministic slot coordinates under row-major and column-major fill modes.
assertions: Source indexes and row/column coordinates are asserted.
The PDF catalog shows both physical arrangements.
Empty slots remain explicit in the placement manifest.

tests.title: supports column-major ordering and exposes all slots on a partial final sheet
renders row-major, column-major, collated, and uncollated page order

features.name: Contain, cover, none, and upscale control
features.definition: Content can be contained, cover-cropped, or left at native scale, with enlargement controlled independently.
assertions: Contain scaling is capped at one unless allowUpscale is enabled.
Cover output exceeds the cell in one axis and is clipped.
None mode preserves scale one.

tests.title: caps contain scaling unless allowUpscale is enabled
clips cover-scaled content to each slot
renders contain, cover, none, alignment, upscale, and auto-rotation modes

features.name: Horizontal and vertical alignment
features.definition: Left, center, right and bottom, middle, top alignment combinations place native-size content at exact cell offsets.
assertions: All nine alignment combinations are asserted numerically.
Right/top and left/bottom output are included in the visual catalog.

tests.title: positions unscaled content for every horizontal and vertical alignment
renders contain, cover, none, alignment, upscale, and auto-rotation modes

features.name: Auto-rotation and intrinsic page rotation
features.definition: Auto-rotation selects a strictly better fit, while intrinsic PDF rotations are normalized into placement geometry and rendering.
assertions: A better 90 degree fit is selected while ties stay unrotated.
Intrinsic 0, 90, 180, and 270 degree pages render in one 2x2 sheet.
UserUnit and nonzero box origins remain physically correct.

tests.title: selects a strictly better auto-rotation and keeps ties unrotated
renders intrinsic rotations at 0, 90, 180, and 270 degrees
normalizes source UserUnit, nonzero boxes, and rotation into physical points

features.name: Media, crop, bleed, trim, and art source boxes
features.definition: Each supported source box is honored, including nonzero origins, with deterministic fallback warnings when the requested box is absent.
assertions: Explicit box coordinates are asserted for all five box types.
The visual catalog shows the progressively smaller source regions.
A missing trim box falls back to crop with a typed warning.

tests.title: uses explicit trim, bleed, and art boxes without fallback warnings
renders every source page box and records a deterministic fallback warning

features.name: Copies with collated and uncollated ordering
features.definition: Selected pages are expanded by copy count into either document-major or page-major order without mutating caller options.
assertions: Exact source-page and copy-index sequences are asserted.
The PDF catalog renders both two-copy sequences.

tests.title: expands collated and uncollated copies without mutating caller options
renders row-major, column-major, collated, and uncollated page order

features.name: Per-slot clipping
features.definition: Every placement is clipped to its cell so cover-scaled or native-size overflow cannot enter neighboring slots.
assertions: The content rectangle deliberately exceeds the cell.
Raster snapshots verify that overflow is absent outside the clip.

tests.title: clips cover-scaled content to each slot
renders contain, cover, none, alignment, upscale, and auto-rotation modes

features.name: Placement, sheet, grid, and numeric limits
features.definition: Invalid page indexes, impossible geometry, excessive grids, normalized overflows, and configured placement or sheet limits fail before rendering.
assertions: Every failure uses a stable package-prefixed error.
No PDF is expected for rejection behavior; the linked PDF is a related valid boundary example.

tests.title: rejects $name with a stable package error
rejects a non-finite final draw scale from adversarial source geometry

features.name: Typed fallback and annotation warnings
features.definition: Lossy or substituted behavior is surfaced through deterministic warning codes and source-page indexes.
assertions: Missing boxes produce page-box-fallback warnings.
Unsupported annotations produce annotations-omitted warnings and are absent from output.
Blank logical pages remain placements.

tests.title: preserves blank placements and warns when source annotations cannot be copied
renders every source page box and records a deterministic fallback warning

features.name: Deterministic plans, manifests, and PDF bytes
features.definition: Identical source bytes and options produce deeply equal placement plans and byte-identical PDFs.
assertions: Repeated plans are deeply equal.
Repeated PDFs are byte-identical.
Every artifact manifest records normalized options, placements, and a SHA-256 digest.

tests.title: normalizes negative intrinsic rotations and returns deterministic plans
produces byte-identical output for identical inputs and options

features.name: Shared resources across 100 client statements
features.definition: A single 100-page PDF repeats variable invoice-statement data for 100 clients while embedding the constant logo and font once; imposition likewise reuses every unique source page Form.
assertions: One source load and one embedPages call are asserted.
Only two Form XObjects exist for twelve placements of two source pages.
The generator emits 100 client pages with one image embed and one font embed, bounded PDF size, exact client coverage, and inspectable page renders.

tests.title: loads once, embeds each unique source page once, and reuses forms across sheets
shares constant image and font resources across 100 statement pages

features.name: Multi-page invoice with terminal total rows
features.definition: A bound invoice table flows across three A4 pages with repeated headings and exactly one subtotal, tax, and total group at the end.
assertions: All source rows have contiguous, nonduplicated page ranges.
Control totals and the terminal page are asserted.
Every rendered page is snapshot-tested.

tests.title: renders a bound invoice table with terminal total rows across multiple A4 pages

features.name: Multi-page bank extract with closing balance
features.definition: A bound transaction table flows across three A4 pages with running balances, repeated headings, and one final closing-balance row.
assertions: All transactions have contiguous, nonduplicated page ranges.
Opening and closing control balances are recorded in the manifest.
Every rendered page is snapshot-tested.

tests.title: renders a bank extract with a terminal closing-balance row across multiple A4 pages
